questions.title: Handling Exactly Once Processing with Webhooks
questions.fix: Store each event_id in a database table with a UNIQUE/PRIMARY KEY constraint and insert it before processing with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, so only the first insert proceeds and duplicate events are skipped.

questions.title: Multi-Tenant n8n Workflows with Shared Logic but Isolated State
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Use one shared workflow that loads per-tenant configuration (credentials, rate limits, database, settings) dynamically by tenant_id, while keeping queues and workers separate for high-volume tenants.

questions.title: Code nodes freeze
questions.fix: Avoid using $('Node') / $node['Node'] / $items() references inside the Code nodes (e.g. add a Merge node before the Code node and read $input.all(), or resolve values with expressions in a Set or HTTP Request node) so the task runner doesn't hang requesting the full workflow when an AI Agent with memory/tool sub-nodes is present.

questions.title: Facebook Leads form Trigger not sending Campaign details
questions.fix: After the Facebook Lead Ads trigger fires, call the Facebook Graph API with GET /{adset.id}?fields=campaign{id,name} (for example via an HTTP Request node) to retrieve the campaign ID and name, since the trigger output only includes ad and adset.

questions.title: Unable to install tenable community node
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Stop trying to install the broken n8n-nodes-tenable-community package (its package structure fails to load in n8n) and instead use the HTTP Request node against the Tenable API, or install the alternative package n8n-nodes-tenable.

questions.title: Email customisation not being picked up
questions.fix: Make sure the custom handlebars template files are present in the container and readable by the n8n process user (fix ownership/permissions, e.g. chown node:node and chmod 644), then restart the task so the templates are loaded at startup.

questions.title: Evaluations not working - runs first data point only
questions.fix: Make sure the workflow uses the 'When fetching a dataset row' evaluation trigger with a valid dataset linked to it (unlink and relink the dataset if needed), because the 'Evaluate All' button only appears in that case.

questions.title: Workflow Randomly Reprocessing Old Queue Jobs After Worker Restart
questions.fix: Make processing idempotent by checking for an already-processed status before running and enforcing database-level deduplication (unique keys / ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), because queue mode can re-run unacknowledged jobs after a worker crash or restart.

questions.title: Is there a way to set Snowflake QUERY_TAG from n8n?
questions.fix: Send ALTER SESSION SET QUERY_TAG as the first input item and the real query as a later item into a single Snowflake node (Query set to {{ $json.sql }}), because all items of one node execution share one connection/session.

questions.title: HTTP Request Node Returning 429 Errors
questions.fix: Throttle the requests so they stay under the API's rate limit, by using the HTTP Request node's Batching option (items per batch and batch interval) or Loop Over Items with a Wait node, and by enabling Retry On Fail.

questions.title: Wireshark trace analysis
questions.fix: Convert the .pcap to JSON outside n8n with tshark (tshark -r capture.pcap -T json), then upload it to n8n via a Webhook node and filter by IP/MAC in a Code node.

questions.title: AI agent or OpenAI node keep loading data on successful workflow run
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Reduce the size of the transcript sent to the AI Agent/OpenAI node (chunk it into smaller pieces or use a larger-context model) and view the finished run via the Executions list, since the very large payload stalls the UI output panel.

questions.title: Which Google Vertex AI model do people actually use for image generation with reference images + prompt?
questions.fix: Send the HTTP Request body in the Vertex AI Imagen REST format, with each reference image nested as referenceImages[].referenceImage.image containing bytesBase64Encoded and mimeType, a valid referenceType such as REFERENCE_TYPE_RAW, and n8n expression values wrapped in .toJsonString().

questions.title: How to access a single cell in Google Sheets?
questions.fix: Make sure the HTTP Request targets the right spreadsheet ID and that it contains a tab named exactly 'Sheet2', so the A1 range 'Sheet2!C5' is valid for Google's values.update endpoint.

questions.title: Gemini API 503 Error on Free Tier, Does Paying Help?
questions.fix: Enable 'Retry On Fail' with a delay in the Gemini node's settings so transient 503 overload errors from Google are retried, and split the large Search-grounded request into smaller calls (enabling billing on the Google project also improves availability).

questions.title: Partial Failures Between n8n and PostgreSQL
questions.fix: Make the workflow state-driven and idempotent: store an idempotency key per operation with a PostgreSQL unique constraint (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) and status values (pending/processing/completed), so a recovery workflow can check whether the API call already happened before retrying.

questions.title: Ollama credentials error
questions.fix: Set the Ollama credential's Base URL to the Raspberry Pi's LAN IP address and Ollama port (for example http://192.168.x.x:11434), after making sure the Ollama service is running, because localhost inside the n8n Docker container does not reach Ollama on the host.

questions.title: Code Node fetch is not defined Error When Calling External API
questions.fix: Replace fetch with the HTTP Request node, or inside the Code node call this.helpers.httpRequest({method, url, json: true}), because fetch is not available in the Code node sandbox.

questions.title: Issue with setting up Project Viewer Role
questions.fix: Recognize that the Project Viewer role is only available on Enterprise plans (self-hosted Enterprise or Cloud Enterprise), not on Pro, so the customer must upgrade their plan to Enterprise to use it.

questions.title: Connect AI node to Claude pro/max account
questions.fix: Create an Anthropic API account with billing/credits and use its API key in an n8n Anthropic credential, since Claude Pro/Max chat subscriptions cannot be used for n8n AI nodes.

questions.title: Expression Returning [undefined] Instead of Value
questions.fix: Check the actual data structure in the previous node's output and fix the expression path (for example {{$json.id}} or optional chaining {{$json.user?.id}}), or reference the earlier node explicitly with {{$node["Set"].json["user"]["id"]}}, because $json only reads the current item and returns undefined when the path doesn't exist.

questions.title: What email do you use for your automations? Problem in node ‘Send Quote‘ The OAuth client was disabled. (item 0)
questions.fix: Stop using a newly created throwaway Google account and connect n8n via OAuth2 credentials with an established account (e.g. Google Workspace), avoiding rapid repeated runs, and appeal the disablement to Google.

questions.title: Forcing a waiting node to proceed
questions.fix: Replace the time-based Wait with a Wait node set to resume 'On Webhook Call', store $execution.resumeUrl with the target date, and call that resume URL (via HTTP Request) when the date is reached or the wait must be expedited.

questions.title: Workflow intermittently crashes and goes inactive on the same PDF file (n8n Cloud, Starter plan)
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Reduce peak memory on the Cloud instance by preventing parallel runs of the PDF path and dropping the binary data right after 'Extract From File' (e.g. with a Set node keeping only the text field), so the execution does not hit the Starter plan memory limit and crash.

questions.title: N8n oauth config
questions.fix: Create and store the credentials in n8n's Credentials UI (encrypted in n8n's database, not in .env), back up N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY, and for Gmail publish the Google OAuth consent screen to Production so refresh tokens don't expire after 7 days.

questions.title: Insignia curso level 1
questions.fix: An n8n team member or course admin must verify the user's course completion and unique ID in the course/badge system and award the forum badge, which the customer cannot do themselves.

questions.title: AI Agent Node Won’t Pass Binary Data to HTTP Request Node
questions.fix: Because the agent calls tools with a JSON-only payload, binary data cannot cross the agent-to-tool boundary, so the file must be handled outside the agent: either store it and pass a reference (URL/path/ID) through the agent, or run the binary HTTP Request in a normal HTTP Request node after or outside the agent.

questions.title: Restricting n8n Chat/Workflow Access to Specific Users or Groups (AD Integration?)
questions.fix: Put a Webhook node with header auth in front of the workflow instead of exposing the chat trigger publicly, verify the caller's token against AD/LDAP group membership with an HTTP Request node, and use an If node to route or filter by group/topic.

questions.title: Way to Handle API Rate Limits Across Hundreds of Tenants in n8n
questions.fix: Enforce per-tenant rate limiting by tracking each tenant's request count in Redis or a database, and process a job only when that tenant is within its limit, with separate queues and dedicated workers for high-volume tenants.

questions.title: How to prevent duplicate emails in AI Agent workflow when ready_to_email stays true
questions.fix: Store the 'email sent' flag outside the AI in a Postgres table keyed by Telegram chat ID, look it up before the IF node, and send the email only when the AI says ready AND the database says not yet sent, then update the row to true after sending.

questions.title: Some n8n workflows have no execution history
questions.basis: JC: needs a human; two labels agree on the category
questions.fix: Set N8N_LOG_LEVEL=debug and watch the n8n logs at the scheduled time to see whether the trigger fires and an execution row is saved, then check that the workflows are Active and that pruning is not trimming runs.

questions.title: Credentials - Custom Auth with API
questions.fix: In the PATCH body, set data.json to a stringified JSON string (e.g. "{\"headers\":{\"Authorization\":\"Bearer 1234\"}}") instead of a nested object, because the Custom Auth credential stores its json field as a string.

questions.title: Why my node cannot load the binary data
questions.fix: Stop decoding the downloaded binary as UTF-8 text in the Code node and instead run it through a parser matched to the real file type (e.g. Extract From File for PDF/CSV/XLSX, a DOCX extractor, or OCR for images).

questions.title: Problems with Python code node in n8n
questions.basis: labelers agree on category; tie-breaker settled reference doubt
questions.fix: In the n8n-runner service, use the correct environment variable names (N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_BROKER_URI=http://n8n:5679 instead of N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_URL, and N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED_TASK_TYPES=javascript,python instead of N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED_MODES) so the external task runner can connect to the broker.

questions.title: Drawing/Annotation inside the flow
questions.fix: Recognize that the on-screen drawing/arrows seen in the video are not an n8n feature but a third-party screen annotation tool (such as ScreenBrush or ZoomIt) used while recording.

questions.title: How can I update an under-review community node to use the latest npm build?
questions.fix: Email help@n8n.io asking n8n staff to switch the Creator Portal review for both packages from the submitted versions (0.1.8 and 0.1.9) to the latest npm version 0.2.0.

questions.title: How can I setup ffmpeg in n8n cloud?
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Because n8n Cloud does not allow installing custom binaries or shell access, call an external FFmpeg-as-a-service API (such as RenderIO, via its n8n node or an HTTP Request node) to run the FFmpeg commands instead of running FFmpeg on the instance.

questions.title: Handling PostgreSQL Failover in Production with n8n
questions.fix: Run PostgreSQL with replication and automatic failover (e.g. Patroni or a managed service) behind PgBouncer so workers reconnect to the promoted replica, and design workflows to be idempotent so retries after failover don't duplicate side effects.

questions.title: Slack discussion using N8N worflow
questions.fix: Add an IF node right after the Slack Trigger that filters out messages sent by the bot itself (those with a bot_id), so the bot's own Slack replies don't re-trigger the workflow.

questions.title: Enterprise plan costs
questions.fix: Contact n8n sales for a custom enterprise quote, since enterprise pricing is not published; alternatively self-host Community Edition if enterprise features are not needed.

questions.title: Vector nodes store wrong dimension - always 192
questions.fix: In the Embeddings OpenAI node, add the Dimensions option and set it to 768 by switching the field to Expression mode and typing 768, so the node requests and stores 768-dimension vectors from the LM-Studio backend instead of 192.

questions.title: Azure Ai Search Vector Store: Hybrid Search (Keyword Search) not working
questions.basis: labelers agree on category; tie-breaker settled reference doubt
questions.fix: Bypass the buggy native Azure AI Search Vector Store node by calling the Azure AI Search REST API directly with an HTTP Request node (optionally wrapped in a sub-workflow), and update n8n once a fix is released.

questions.title: WooCommerce Product Updated Webhook (Continuously Firing)
questions.fix: Add an IF node after the WooCommerce Trigger that compares the product's date_modified field to the current time (e.g. within the last 5 minutes) and only continues for recently modified products, because WooCommerce itself fires product.updated for stock changes, lookup table regeneration and other metadata writes.

questions.title: Does `Defined automatically byt he model` can handle data in nested structure column?
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Switch the Postgres Tool node operation to Execute Query and set the Query field to a $fromAI expression, while describing the JSONB column structure in the tool description so the model writes SQL that uses the ->> operator for nested keys.

questions.title: Form Trigger fails in queue mode - Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'execute')
questions.basis: labelers agree on category; tie-breaker settled reference doubt
questions.fix: Make the worker run the same n8n image/version and the same configuration (encryption key, DB and Redis settings) as the main instance, with the container command set to `worker`, and redeploy both so the worker can load the node type it is asked to execute.

questions.title: Prod N8N WhatsApp Trigger not working
questions.fix: Re-activate the WhatsApp workflow (unpublish/republish, or automate it via a scheduled workflow calling the n8n public API /workflows/{id}/activate with an X-N8N-API-KEY) so n8n re-registers the webhook subscription with Meta.

questions.title: Automation Lost in Self Hosted n8n
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Open the exported workflow JSON in a text editor, delete the top-level "id" field, save it, and re-import so n8n generates a new workflow ID instead of colliding with the stale one in the database.

questions.title: Credentials in different workflows are changed without changes made
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Create a separate credential for each service (one for WordPress, one for MailChimp) instead of editing one shared Basic Auth credential, because nodes that select the same credential all point at that one stored object.

questions.title: Database Sharding in a Large Multi-Tenant n8n Platform
questions.fix: Don't shard early: start with a single PostgreSQL database with tenant_id on all tables, indexing and partitioning, and move only large or noisy tenants to dedicated databases once performance or backup problems appear.

questions.title: Expression can access fields on an earlier node that were added only in a later node
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Understand that `.item` in `$('Edit Fields - normalize').item` resolves through n8n's item linking, and use `.first()` or `.all()` if you need the node's own output (the accepted answer's claim; the enriched field may instead come from the shared object reference being mutated in the Edit Fields node).

questions.title: Text Classifier
questions.fix: Rewrite each Text Classifier category description to be specific and descriptive (e.g. what kinds of emails belong to it), so the LLM stops defaulting to the 'Others' category and routes to the matching Gmail node.

questions.title: List Google Sheet pages?
questions.fix: Use an HTTP Request node with the existing Google Sheets OAuth credentials to call the Google Sheets API GET https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId} with the query parameter fields=sheets.properties, which returns each tab's sheetId and title as JSON.

questions.title: OpenAI (ChatGPT), gives different numerical answers to the same question based on the same dataset
questions.fix: Add the Calculator tool (toolCalculator) to the AI Agent node so numerical work goes through a tool instead of the LLM counting rows itself.

questions.title: OpenAI "Message a model" node fails with "Missing fileName parameter" error
questions.fix: Switch the Type field of Message 1 from Expression mode back to Fixed, select 'Text' in the Type dropdown so the Prompt field appears, then enter the prompt text there (and set the Model).

questions.title: Getting error on publishing my first workflow
questions.fix: Make sure only one Telegram Trigger node (one webhook) is registered per bot, because Telegram allows a single webhook per bot and extra triggers cause 'Too Many Requests' errors on activation.

questions.title: How to create a language section in Tutorials
questions.fix: Community members cannot create new forum category sections themselves, so the user should open a topic in the Feedback category so the n8n team can decide on adding a Polish Tutorials section, and meanwhile post in an existing section.

questions.title: Managing objects promotion across instances in an enterprise environment
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Have QA's native source-control push (with selected workflows in the commit modal) write n8n's own serialized files to the dev branch, then cherry-pick the specific workflows/<id>.json and credential_stubs/<id>.json files from that branch into an isolated per-promotion branch and MR via Git, instead of converting API output.

questions.title: MCP Server Trigger or Available in MCP" toggle in n8n
questions.basis: labelers agree on category; tie-breaker settled reference doubt
questions.fix: Use the workflow-level 'Available in MCP' toggle when you just want an existing workflow (with its current trigger) exposed via MCP, and add the MCP Server Trigger node only when you need a dedicated MCP endpoint exposing specific tools.

questions.title: WhatsApp Business Node: "Document" option missing in Header Parameters for approved templates
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Replace the WhatsApp Business Cloud node with an HTTP Request node that POSTs to the WhatsApp Cloud API messages endpoint, with a template payload whose header component has a parameter of type 'document' containing a link and filename.

questions.title: AI Agent unable to extract structured data from audio URL / binary (Gemini 3 Flash via LLM Proxy)
questions.fix: Transcribe the audio to text first by calling the LiteLLM speech-to-text endpoint with an HTTP Request node, then pass the resulting transcript text to the AI Agent for structured JSON extraction.

questions.title: Slack Trigger receives no events despite verified webhook and correct Slack configuration
questions.fix: Disable Socket Mode in the Slack App settings (Event Subscriptions page shows a notice when it is enabled), because with Socket Mode on Slack delivers events over a websocket instead of to the n8n webhook URL.

questions.title: Help With Pagination | With SAP
questions.fix: Configure the HTTP Request node's Options > Pagination to follow the next-page URL from the response's 'odata.nextLink' field (Response Contains Next URL, with the base URL prepended), and stop when that field is absent.

questions.title: MQTT node doesn't have TLS; only SSL
questions.fix: In the n8n MQTT credentials, set Protocol to mqtts (port 8883), enable SSL, and add the HiveMQ CA certificate (plus client cert/key if needed) so the connection uses TLS.

questions.title: Level 2 – "Getting data from the warehouse" still showing ❌ after completing workflow
questions.fix: Make sure the unique ID is set exactly in the workflow's Set node and re-execute the workflow so the HTTP Request node reports progress to the course tracker successfully.

questions.title: Now receiving an error in a set node that only days ago it was working great
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Replace the Set node expression with a Code node that reads the blocked property via bracket notation (function['arguments']) and JSON.parse()s the stringified Vapi arguments, since n8n's expression sandbox blocks access to 'arguments'.

questions.title: How to read the raw content from the file
questions.fix: After the Read/Write Files from Disk node, add an Extract from File node (e.g. Extract From Text File, or Move Binary Data) to convert the binary file data into text, then reference the resulting text field (e.g. {{ $json.data }}) in the HTTP Request node's auth token.

questions.title: Workflow randomly stop when processing large API
questions.fix: Change the Function node's final statement from `return results[0];` to `return results;` so the full array of items is passed to the next node instead of only the first item.

questions.title: N8n AI Agent PostgreSQL Tool shows invalid/missing schema error (query input not working)
questions.fix: Work around the n8n 2.26.x bug that builds an invalid tool schema ('must be type object, got None') by either dropping the agent tool (generate SQL with a Message a Model node and run it in a regular Postgres node) or downgrading to n8n 2.15.

questions.title: Building a WhatsApp Chatbot... Can't Get Trial Number
questions.fix: Attach the Meta app to a business portfolio (Meta Business account) so the WhatsApp API setup tab and test number appear, then add the recipient numbers (up to 5) on that screen.

questions.title: Using n8n as a SCIM facade in front of third-party REST API
questions.fix: Build the SCIM v2 facade with Webhook nodes that use path variables (e.g. /scim/v2/Users/:id) for each HTTP method, then use Switch and Code nodes to transform the third-party API's responses into the strict SCIM JSON envelope (schemas, totalResults, Resources, meta) returned through Respond to Webhook.

questions.title: Adding python
questions.fix: Run an external task runner as a second Docker container (n8nio/runners image) alongside n8n, and add the task runner environment variables to the docker compose setup, since n8n v2 only supports Python code execution via external task runners.

questions.title: How do you decide when an AI Agent should stop chatting and trigger backend logic in n8n?
questions.basis: labelers agree on category; tie-breaker settled reference doubt
questions.fix: Turn the backend HTTP request (flight API call) into a tool that the AI Agent calls and waits on, and set the tool nodes' On Error setting to 'Continue (using error output)' or 'continue with error message' so failures return to the agent instead of stopping the workflow.

questions.title: Credential name auto-increment seems global for custom credentials, but per-person for some built-ins (OpenAI)
questions.fix: Accept that the auto-generated credential name counter is not configurable or scoped per user/project, and manually rename credentials (e.g. include the project or user name) to avoid the global suffix.

questions.title: I am planning to offer Automations on a local company here in Muscat. Any tips? *This is my first time
questions.fix: Prepare a business-focused proposal for the client: audit their current manual task time, quantify cost savings per month and year, and cover security, ownership of credentials and maintenance, rather than technical details.

questions.title: ABCorp's old data warehouse
questions.fix: Stop waiting for the welcome email: the Level 1 course (with the ABCorp data warehouse exercise) has been retired, so switch to the replacement n8n Academy beginner course N8N101, Essentials: Your First Workflows, whose exercises use built-in practice APIs.

questions.title: Can I use community edition?
questions.fix: Under the Sustainable Use License, self-hosting n8n as an internal orchestration layer is allowed for JData's own business purposes. It is not allowed if a sold module's value comes entirely or substantially from n8n, and that case requires an Enterprise or Embed license.

questions.title: Model Selector node as fallback mechanism when primary LLM fail
questions.basis: labelers agree on category; tie-breaker settled reference doubt
questions.fix: Configure the Model Selector rules to test the error with the {{ $error.message }} expression (e.g. contains 429 or rate limit, plus a catch-all rule on {{ $error }} not being empty) instead of $json.execution.error.message, so each rule routes to the fallback model.

questions.title: How to change the Worspace Owner?
questions.fix: The current owner logs in, goes to Settings (personal settings), and replaces their own account email address with the new owner's email address, so the owner account passes to the new person.

questions.title: Level 1 Certification Badge Missing
questions.fix: Retake the Level 1 certification test and enter the correct community username so the badge is granted and synced to the community profile.

questions.title: Community node with WebSocket dependency — path to verification?
questions.fix: Skip the WebSocket-based community node and instead create a Supabase database webhook (using the pg_net extension) that POSTs table INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE events to an n8n Webhook node URL.

questions.title: Supabase Vector Store insert fails on custom kb_chunks schema (source_id null) in n8n 2.17.7
questions.fix: Add a Postgres BEFORE INSERT trigger on kb_chunks that copies source_id, source_type and chunk_index out of the metadata jsonb into the top-level columns, because the Supabase Vector Store node only writes content, embedding and metadata.

questions.title: { "nodes": [ { "parameters": { "url": "=https://newsapi.org/v2/everything?apiKey={{ $('Setup1').first().json.apiKey }}&q={{ $json.output.clean_company_name }}&from={{ DateTime.now().minus({ days: $('Setup1').first().json.newsAge }).toF
questions.fix: Make the data reach the Edit Fields/Gmail nodes by fixing the node-name references and placing Normalize company name, Get latest news and Edit Fields on one connected path (adding a Merge node if branches are separate), and by using the expression in the field value rather than the field name.

questions.title: Why can't I pay for more Memory/RAM?
questions.basis: labelers agree on category; tie-breaker settled reference doubt
questions.fix: Move off the Pro plan: upgrade to the Enterprise plan (the only Cloud tier with more RAM) or self-host n8n, since Pro memory cannot be increased by purchase.

questions.title: How to add retry system in flow as we do using the code
questions.basis: JC couldn't tell: tie-breaker's label (flagged; reported both ways)
questions.fix: Track a retry counter yourself (e.g., a Set node initializing retryCount = 0 before the LLM call), and on the IF node's unbalanced branch check retryCount < 1, increment it, and loop back to the LLM node; otherwise continue the normal flow.

questions.title: Is it possible, AI send product image to user
questions.basis: JC: needs a human; the only human-side label (flagged)
questions.fix: Use a single AI agent that outputs structured JSON (intent, product_id), route on it with a Switch node, look up the product image URL in Airtable, and send it through the Messenger Send API as an image attachment. Because Airtable attachment URLs are signed and expire, upload the image to Messenger's attachment_upload endpoint (or re-host it on stable storage) first.

questions.title: MCP get_workflow_details returns empty workflow.tags for tagged workflows
questions.fix: Bypass the MCP get_workflow_details tool, which returns an empty tags array because of a likely MCP implementation gap, and fetch the workflow with the public REST API (GET /api/v1/workflows/{id}) using an API key to get the tags.

questions.title: Unable to create/edit any workflows
questions.fix: Query the user and role_scope tables in Postgres to confirm the user's roleSlug is global:owner, then insert the missing owner scope rows (found by comparing the scope table against role_scope for global:owner), because nothing reconciles role_scope at boot.

questions.title: REDIS Lost / Recovered only inside n8n
questions.fix: Set the Aiven Redis/Valkey service's idle timeout (redis_timeout, or valkey_timeout on newer services) to 0 or a much higher value, so Aiven stops closing idle n8n queue-mode connections after 300 seconds.

questions.title: API n8n - Version 2.X
questions.fix: Use the API key of the account that owns the workflow (or the project it belongs to) to deactivate it, since in 2.x the Owner's API key lacks the scope to act on workflows in other users' personal projects; alternatively upgrade to a licensed plan with RBAC/project-level access.

questions.title: Anyone facing Google access blocked error?
questions.fix: In the Google Cloud console, switch the OAuth consent screen publishing status from Testing to Production, then reconnect/refresh the Google credential in n8n.

questions.title: Duplicate WhatsApp Messages
questions.fix: Deduplicate by WhatsApp message_id: store it with a 'processing' status in a persistent store (e.g. a database or data table) before processing and sending the reply, check for an existing entry when a webhook arrives, and update it to 'completed' afterward.

questions.title: Tool calling chain with local Ollama models (7b/14b) - 2nd tool never executed
questions.fix: Switch to a model that reliably supports tool calling (e.g. qwen3:8b, tagged for tools in Ollama) with the Ollama Chat Model node, and if the second call is still dropped, split the orchestration into a lightweight router agent plus sub-agents that each have fewer tools.

questions.title: Level 2 - Workflow 3 - Encountering error messaage
questions.fix: Skip sending the message to the course Discord channel: verifying with the unique ID and the link from the questionnaire email (a 14/15 score) is enough to pass the course level.

questions.title: No Available Server Issue - Setting High Availability mode in Kubernetes
questions.fix: Run n8n in queue mode (EXECUTIONS_MODE=queue) with shared Postgres and Redis, and enable multi-main (N8N_MULTI_MAIN_SETUP_ENABLED=true) on multiple main pods behind a load balancer; multi-main requires an Enterprise license.

questions.title: Sanity check: case-based automation workflow with file intake, anonymization, and timed lifecycle management
questions.fix: Use a dispatcher workflow with sub-workflows, persist case state in an external store or n8n data tables, trigger later stages via webhooks or a message queue (RabbitMQ/Redis/SQS) instead of long delayed executions, keep files outside n8n, and build a separate client portal.

questions.title: Way to Prevent Message Ordering Issues in a High-Volume WhatsApp Automation System
questions.fix: Partition or queue incoming messages by user_id (optionally with a per-user Redis lock) so that all messages for one user are processed serially by a single worker while different users run in parallel.

questions.title: Constructs like “{{ $(‘books_card-1’).item.json.books_array.book_link }}” have stopped working for me
questions.basis: JC: the key step is on the page
questions.fix: Set the environment variable N8N_EXPRESSION_ENGINE=legacy and restart n8n, because since 2.35.0 the default expression engine changed from legacy to vm and breaks these expressions.

questions.title: Verification question: existing node has a runtime dep that blocks it — does a fresh package qualify?
questions.basis: JC couldn't tell: tie-breaker's label (flagged; reported both ways)

You’re hitting the API’s rate limit, so the fix is to slow the requests down or send them in smaller batches [1][2].

1. In your **HTTP Request** node, open **Settings** and enable **Retry On Fail** [4].  
2. Set **Wait Between Tries (ms)** to a value above the API’s limit. For example, if the API allows 1 request per second, use `1000` [4].  
3. If you’re sending many items, use **Add Option > Batching** in the **HTTP Request** node [2][3].  
4. Set **Items per Batch** to a smaller number, then set **Batch Interval (ms)** to pause between batches — for example `1000` for one request per second [2][3].  
5. If you need more control, put a **Loop Over Items** node before the HTTP Request node and a **Wait** node after it, then connect the **Wait** node back to **Loop Over Items** [4]. This is the general pattern for pacing requests.

Also check the API’s own rate-limit docs, because the right batch size and delay depend on that service [1]. If the API supports it, pagination in the **HTTP Request** node can also reduce how much data you request per call [8].

2. If you can’t give every instance its own DB, n8n recommends Postgres schemas as an alternative at the instance level [1].
3. For scaling execution throughput, n8n’s supported pattern is queue mode with Redis + workers, not database sharding as a documented n8n feature [6].

- schema-per-tenant
- database-per-tenant
- sharding tenants across multiple DBs
- when to shard for hundreds/thousands of tenants

- n8n Cloud vs self-hosted

296374.text:
This looks like normal queue-mode recovery after a worker loses its job lock or restarts, so the same execution can be picked up again unless your workflow is idempotent [7].

1. Treat the workflow as at-least-once, not exactly-once.
   - In queue mode, n8n workers execute jobs and n8n can recover executions if a worker stops renewing its lock or a running execution is found without a queue job [7].
   - That means duplicate DB writes/API calls must be prevented by your workflow design, not by assuming “processed once”.

2. Make the first write idempotent.
   - Your check `if ($json.status !== "processed")` is not enough on its own if two executions run close together.
   - Use a unique key from the incoming payload and enforce uniqueness in your database, or do an “insert-if-not-exists / upsert” pattern. This is general database/API idempotency practice.

3. Persist a processing state before doing side effects.
   - Example pattern:
     - Step A: write a record like `status = processing` with a unique request/job ID.
     - Step B: only continue if that record was created by this execution.
     - Step C: after all external calls succeed, update to `status = processed`.
   - If the workflow restarts, the second run sees the existing record and skips or resumes safely.

4. Add deduplication around external API calls.
   - If the API supports idempotency keys, send one.
   - If it doesn’t, store the remote request ID/result in your DB before retrying.

5. Check whether the worker is actually crashing or losing its lock.
   - n8n’s queue-mode crash detection includes `stall` and `queue-recovery` [7].
   - If this happens often, look for worker restarts, memory pressure, or deployment restarts.

6. If you use queue mode with binary data in filesystem, switch away from that.
   - n8n doesn’t support queue mode with binary data storage in filesystem; use S3 external storage instead [1].

If you want, share your exact worker setup and I can help you turn your current logic into an idempotent pattern.

This isn’t something n8n-specific docs here can fully prescribe, so a human should design the recovery pattern with your exact business rules. I can still point out the safe direction:

- Use an **idempotency key** for every job so retries can be recognized as the same logical request.
- Keep a **status field** in PostgreSQL (`pending` → `processing` → `completed` / `failed`) so the database is the source of truth.
- Prefer an **outbox pattern** if the API call must not be lost: write the business change and an “event to send” record in the same DB transaction, then let a separate workflow/process deliver it later.
- If the API succeeds but n8n crashes before saving the result, the retry must be able to **detect “already sent”** by checking the idempotency key or the outbox record before sending again.
- Move to a **dead-letter state** only after a bounded number of retries or when the failure is clearly non-retryable (for example, invalid data, missing credential, or permanently rejected request).

For multi-tenant production, the safest default is usually: shared workflow logic, but isolate tenant state outside the workflow and scale execution with queue mode.  

1. Use **one shared workflow** for common logic, and keep tenant-specific values in an external config store or per-tenant lookup layer. n8n’s OEM docs explicitly describe this pattern as valid: a single workflow can be reused if your product passes in user credentials when executing [7].  
2. Put n8n in **queue mode** for scale so production executions are handled by workers instead of the main process [1][6]. This is the main n8n-supported way to scale execution volume.  
3. Use **Postgres, not SQLite**, for production [8]. The queue setup relies on Redis plus a database [6], and SQLite is not supported for distributed queue mode [6].  
4. Avoid putting binary files on local filesystem if you’re using queue mode; use external storage like S3 instead [1].  
5. For high-volume tenants, a practical pattern is **shared logic + separate worker pools / infrastructure boundaries per tier**. That’s general scaling practice, not a special n8n feature, but it helps prevent one tenant’s load from impacting others.

What I’d avoid:
- One shared instance with all tenants and no isolation at the database/worker level.
- SQLite in production.
- Filesystem binary storage in queue mode.

If you want, I can help you map your specific setup into one of these two designs:
- shared workflow + tenant config/credentials layer
- separate workflow per tenant with centralized deployment updates

You’re running into a classic webhook idempotency problem: n8n can receive the same request twice, so you need to make the workflow safe to retry rather than expecting exactly-once delivery.

1. **Deduplicate by `event_id` before any side effects**
   - In your **Database** node, create a uniqueness rule on `event_id` in the target table. That way the DB becomes the final gate.
   - If your DB supports it, use an **upsert** / `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` pattern. This is general SQL behavior, not n8n-specific.

2. **Split “check + write” from side effects**
   - Webhook → **IF** / database lookup for `event_id` → only continue if it’s new → Process → Database.
   - If the row already exists, stop the workflow or return the existing result.

3. **Make the webhook response reduce retries**
   - In the **Webhook** node, use **Respond** = **When Last Node Finishes** if you want the HTTP response to wait for the workflow result [7].
   - If you use **Respond to Webhook**, note that it only runs once and only returns the first incoming item [7].

4. **If you’re in queue mode, keep the webhook path reliable**
   - In queue mode, the webhook request is received by the main/webhook process and the execution is handed to a worker [1].
   - Make sure your main, workers, and webhook processors are configured consistently with queue mode and Redis [1][8].

What I can say safely: n8n doesn’t provide a built-in “exactly once” guarantee for duplicate webhook deliveries. The reliable fix is idempotency at the workflow/database layer.

If you’re on n8n Cloud or self-hosted n8n, the “owner” is changed by updating the owner’s email — you don’t transfer it to another existing user. [1][3]

1. Log in as the current instance owner.
2. Go to **Settings > Personal**.
3. Edit the **Email** field to the new owner’s email.
4. Click **Save**. [1][3]

Important:
- The new email must **not already be used by another n8n account/user on the instance**. If it is, change or delete that user first. [1][3]
- This changes the owner of the instance, including the login email and invoice/general communication email. [1]
- If the workspace is deactivated, there is no **Settings** page, so this can’t be changed there. [1]

If you manage a **self-hosted** instance owner through environment variables instead, set:
- `N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_MANAGED_BY_ENV=true`
- `N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_EMAIL=<new owner email>`
- keep `N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_FIRST_NAME`, `N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_LAST_NAME`, and `N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_PASSWORD_HASH` set
- restart n8n [3]

Also, if by “workspace name” you meant the instance username, that currently can’t be changed. [1]

A clean pattern in n8n is to let the agent handle conversation, but make the transition to backend logic depend on a deterministic tool call or review step, not on raw user text.

1. Use an **AI Agent** for the chat part, and give it **Memory** so it can keep context across turns. n8n’s Conversational Agent/AI Agent can maintain context, and memory is the supported way to carry the conversation forward [1].

2. Put your backend action behind a **tool** instead of trying to detect keywords in the message. In n8n, agents choose which actions to take, including tools [3]. So the agent can keep asking questions until it has enough data, then call the backend tool when ready.

3. If the backend action is high-impact, gate that tool with **human review**. n8n supports adding an **“Add human review step”** on the tool connection from the AI Agent [8]. That gives you a deterministic “go/no-go” signal instead of trusting free-form text.

4. Keep the workflow split like this:
   - **Chat Trigger** → **AI Agent** for the ongoing conversation [1]
   - **Memory sub-node** for state across turns [1]
   - **Tool connector** for backend logic [6]
   - Optional **human review step** on the tool if you need approval [8]

5. If you need a simple rule, use the agent’s tool usage as the branch point:
   - no tool call = keep chatting

1. **What the toggle does**
   - **“Available in MCP”** makes an existing workflow visible to MCP clients at the instance level, and you still need instance MCP access enabled plus the workflow enabled individually [2][6].
   - That is enough if you want ChatGPT (or another MCP client) to invoke an existing workflow.

   - It supports **SSE** and **streamable HTTP**, not stdio [3].

3. **When to use which**
   - Use **“Available in MCP”** when you want to expose an existing workflow for MCP clients to run or interact with [2][6].
   - Use **MCP Server Trigger** when you’re building an MCP-style workflow that exposes **tools** to an MCP client, for example with a **Custom n8n Workflow Tool** node attached [3].

4. **For your RAG chat workflow**
   - If your workflow already works through the toggle, that’s expected and sufficient for that setup [2][6].
   - You do **not** need the MCP Server Trigger unless you want to redesign the workflow around MCP tool exposure [3].

Your imbalance check is a business-rule retry, so the clean n8n way is to build a small loop with an IF check and a retry counter.

1. Add a counter before the LLM step
   - Use a **Set** node or **Code** node to initialize `retryCount = 0`.

2. Run the LLM and validate the result
   - Keep your LLM node.
   - Use your existing **IF** node to check whether debit = credit.

3. On the “unbalanced” branch, increment the counter
   - Add a **Code** node that sets `retryCount = {{$json.retryCount + 1}}`.

4. Stop after one retry
   - Add another **IF** node after the counter check:
     - If `retryCount < 2`, send the flow back to the node before the LLM.
     - If `retryCount >= 2`, continue down your current “fail / accept as-is” path.
   - n8n supports looping by connecting a node back to a previous node, and using an **IF** node to decide when to stop the loop [1].

5. Keep the retry limited to one extra attempt
   - Because you only loop while `retryCount < 2`, the flow will run the LLM at most twice total.
   - If you want the node to process only the first item in a multi-item input, use **Execute Once** in the node’s **Settings** tab [2]. That is separate from your retry logic.

Notes:
- **Retry On Fail** [2] is only for when a node execution errors. It won’t help if the node “succeeds” but your IF validation says the output is unbalanced.
- If your LLM call can genuinely fail with rate limits or transient errors, you can also enable **Retry On Fail** and set **Wait Between Tries (ms)** appropriately [8]. That’s general API behavior, not specific to your validation loop.

1. **Store case state externally** in a DB or external store, not in n8n execution data. n8n is designed to pass data node-to-node and inspect it during executions [1], but that’s not the same as durable case management.
2. **Use n8n for orchestration, not persistence**: intake trigger, document processing, notifications, timers, and status transitions can be workflow steps [1].
3. **Keep PII separated** in your database or service layer; generate anonymized payloads for processing, then reattach PII only in the final delivery step.

5. **For file handling**, store PDFs in external object storage or a file service and keep only references in n8n; inspect data in node execution views when debugging [1].
6. **For development only**, data pinning can help you test with stable sample data, but pinned data is ignored in production [8].

If this is a **customer-facing platform where users interact with n8n or its workflows**, that can cross into restricted territory under the community license [4] and should be reviewed against the licensing examples [3][4].
